tools.name: analyze_email
tools.description: Analyze one email: returns recommend first, then reasons, score, bounce_risk, syntax/MX/SPF/DKIM/DMARC, disposable, role, provider, enrichment. WHEN TO CALL: signup guard, disposable check, DMARC-before-outreach. WHEN NOT TO CALL: bulk lists >1 address (use analyze_email_batch); re-check of an addre

tools.name: analyze_email_batch
tools.description: Analyze 2–25 emails in one call (same per-item schema as analyze_email; DNS/enrich cached within the batch; duplicates computed once). WHEN TO CALL: small multi-address checks from few domains. WHEN NOT TO CALL: single address (use analyze_email); lists >25 (split). Price: flat via x402 on /email/in

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: analyze_email · Public sink: analyze_email, analyze_email_batch.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: analyze_email · Public sink: analyze_email, analyze_email_batch

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
